hebrewText: ט֗וֹב לְ/הֹד֥וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/לְ/זַמֵּ֖ר לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן

tokens.bdb: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
tokens.kjv: beautiful, best, better, bountiful, cheerful, at ease, [idiom] fair (word), (be in) favour, fine, glad, good (deed, -lier, -liest, -ly, -ness, -s), graciously, joyful, kindly, kindness, liketh (best), loving, merry, [idiom] most, pleasant, [phrase] pleaseth, pleasure, precious, prosperity, ready, sweet, wealth, welfare, (be) well(-favoured).
tokens.enLiteralWord: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun
tokens.explanation: tov — bom, correto, agradável, útil, virtuoso
tokens.explanationEn: good  in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun

tokens.bdb: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
tokens.kjv: give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.enLiteralWord: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanation: play upon it; to make music
tokens.explanationEn: play upon it; to make music

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
an elevation, i.e. (adj.) lofty (compar.); as title, the Supreme
